answer_1.quote: We rely on two widely used debiasing techniques, namely Iterative Nullspace Projection and SentDebias... We debias the last hidden representations of the LLM and implement SentDebias using 2.5% of the Wikipedia text for the respective language.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text which is evaluated for bias using sentence pairs where one sentence is more stereotypical than the other.

answer_2.quote: Following previous setup on generative models, we directly compare the log probability of the two sentences given by LLMs, and choose the one that has larger values.
